verdict.rationale: The only evidence of background automation is a Kimi help-center category that lists 定时任务 (scheduled tasks) among the assistant's general features, so a timed or scheduled task capability appears to exist. Nothing documents how it works or whether it recurs. The other agent evidence (Kimi Code's autonomous dev tasks and the editor's 'automated tasks') describes in-conversation, user-initiated work, not unattended background runs, so it does not count here. missing for 10: documentation of how scheduled tasks are created and configured, evidence of recurring schedules versus one-off timed runs, proof that tasks run unattended in the background, details on outputs or notifications, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
